presets.label: txt2img-basic
presets.description: Basic local text-to-image generation through ComfyUI.

presets.label: txt2img-flux1-dev-fp8
presets.description: Experimental Flux1-dev fp8 text-to-image workflow using a checkpoint-style ComfyUI graph.

presets.label: img2img-basic
presets.description: Basic local image-to-image generation using an uploaded source image.

presets.label: prompt-from-layer-florence2
presets.description: Experimental Florence-2 PromptGen workflow that describes a captured Photoshop layer or canvas.

presets.label: upscale-basic
presets.description: Experimental pixel upscale through ComfyUI UpscaleModelLoader and ImageUpscaleWithModel.

presets.label: upscale-seedvr2-3b
presets.description: Generative 2x upscale with SeedVR2 3B. It restores and redraws detail rather than only enlarging pixels, so it can invent texture that was not in the source.

presets.label: enhance-prompt-superprompt
presets.description: Expands a short prompt into a longer, more descriptive one, entirely locally.

presets.label: layer-maps-depth
presets.description: Estimates a depth pass from a layer and returns it at the layer's own size.

presets.label: layer-maps-lineart
presets.description: Traces a layer into black lines on white, at the layer's own size.

presets.label: layer-maps-normal
presets.description: Estimates a tangent-space normal pass from a layer, at the layer's own size.

presets.label: remove-background-birefnet
presets.description: Cuts the subject out of a layer with BiRefNet and returns it with real alpha.

presets.label: select-sam31
presets.description: Finds what you name in a layer or the canvas with Meta's SAM 3.1 and returns it as a selection mask. No diffusion: the pixels are not changed.

presets.label: camera-angle-qwen-edit-2511
presets.description: Re-shoots the captured layer from another camera position: one of 8 directions, 4 heights and 3 distances, with Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 and fal's multiple-angles LoRA.

presets.label: sketch2img-linecn-basic
presets.description: Experimental SD 1.x LineArt ControlNet sketch guidance workflow.

presets.label: sketch2img-scribble-basic
presets.description: Experimental SD 1.x Scribble ControlNet sketch guidance workflow.

presets.label: sketch2img-depth-basic
presets.description: SD 1.x sketch-to-image workflow that conditions on the source layer's depth rather than its lines.

presets.label: sketch2img-zimage-fun-controlnet
presets.description: Sketch guidance for the Z_image_Turbo diffusion model stack using Alibaba-PAI's Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1 lite model patch.

presets.label: sketch2img-zimage-fun-controlnet-full
presets.description: Sketch guidance for the Z_image_Turbo diffusion model stack using Alibaba-PAI's full Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1 model patch.

presets.label: inpaint-basic
presets.description: Experimental SD 1.x inpainting workflow using a Photoshop selection source and mask.

presets.label: inpaint-flux-fill-basic
presets.description: Experimental Flux Fill inpainting workflow using a diffusion model stack.

presets.label: inpaint-flux-fill-cropstitch
presets.description: Flux Fill inpainting that crops to the mask plus context, samples at 1024px, and stitches the patch back with a blended seam.

presets.label: inpaint-flux2-klein
presets.description: FLUX.2 Klein inpainting that crops to the mask plus context, samples at 1024px in four steps, and stitches the patch back with a blended seam.

presets.label: inpaint-lama
presets.description: Removes the selected object and fills the area from its surroundings with LaMa. No prompt is used. Best on small objects against simple surroundings; a person or anything large comes back as a smear.

presets.label: inpaint-lama-klein
presets.description: Removes large objects such as a person: LaMa fills the selection from its surroundings, then FLUX.2 Klein repaints the fill with real detail. The prompt describes what should be there instead.

presets.label: outpaint-flux-fill-basic
presets.description: Experimental Flux Fill outpainting workflow using ImagePadForOutpaint.

presets.label: txt2img-flux2-klein
presets.description: Fast text-to-image preset for the distilled FLUX.2 Klein 4B diffusion model stack.

presets.label: img2img-flux2-klein
presets.description: Fast image-to-image preset for the distilled FLUX.2 Klein 4B diffusion model stack.

presets.label: multi-reference-flux2-klein
presets.description: Composes several captured layers into one picture by chaining a ReferenceLatent per layer onto both conditioning branches. Carries wardrobe, props and setting; does not carry faces.

presets.label: multi-reference-qwen-image-21 (research licence)
presets.description: Composes several captured layers with Qwen-Image 2.1: each layer is a numbered image input on one encoder, addressed in the prompt by number. Transparent layers keep their alpha. Research-licensed weights.

presets.label: edit-flux2-klein
presets.description: Instruction editing with FLUX.2 Klein: reference conditioning on both branches at denoise 1, so the frame holds while the instruction lands.

presets.label: txt2img-z-image-turbo
presets.description: Experimental text-to-image preset for the Z_image_Turbo diffusion model stack.

presets.label: img2img-z-image-turbo
presets.description: Experimental image-to-image preset for the Z_image_Turbo diffusion model stack.

presets.label: txt2img-krea2-turbo
presets.description: Experimental text-to-image preset for the Krea-2 Turbo diffusion model stack.

presets.label: txt2img-flux2-dev-gguf
presets.description: Experimental Flux.2 dev text-to-image preset using a GGUF-quantised diffusion model and the Mistral-3 text encoder.

presets.label: txt2img-qwen-image-21 (research licence)
presets.description: Text to image with Qwen-Image 2.1: strong lettering and native 2K. Research-licensed weights, gated behind their licence.

presets.label: img2img-krea2-turbo
presets.description: Experimental image-to-image preset for the Krea-2 Turbo diffusion model stack.

presets.label: edit-qwen-image-21 (research licence)
presets.description: Instruction editing with Qwen-Image 2.1: the layer goes in as image_1 and the instruction is applied at denoise 1. A cut-out layer comes back as a cut-out. Research-licensed weights.

presets.label: style-reference-sd15
presets.description: Match a captured layer's mood, color, and visual language onto a new prompt-driven image.

presets.label: unflatten-qwen-layered
presets.description: Splits a flat captured layer into separate layers with real transparency, in stacking order. Needs a subject standing on visible ground; a frame-filling close-up comes back unseparated.

models.label: Background removal model

models.label: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 diffusion model
models.setupHint: Install qwen_image_edit_2511_int8_convrot.safetensors in ComfyUI models/diffusion_models.

models.label: Qwen-Image-Layered diffusion model
models.setupHint: Install qwen_image_layered_fp8mixed.safetensors where ComfyUI's UNETLoader can find it.

models.label: SeedVR2 3B restoration model
models.setupHint: Install seedvr2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors in ComfyUI models/diffusion_models.

models.label: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 Lightning 4-step LoRA
models.setupHint: Install Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors in ComfyUI models/loras.

models.label: Multiple-angles camera LoRA
models.setupHint: Install qwen-image-edit-2511-multiple-angles-lora.safetensors in ComfyUI models/loras.

models.label: Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union patch (lite)
models.setupHint: Install Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1-lite-2602-8steps.safetensors where ComfyUI's ModelPatchLoader can find it.

models.label: Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union patch (full)
models.setupHint: Install Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1.safetensors where ComfyUI's ModelPatchLoader can find it.

models.setupHint: Install clip_l.safetensors in ComfyUI models/text_encoders.

models.label: Qwen2.5-VL 7B text encoder
models.setupHint: Install qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors where ComfyUI's CLIPLoader can find it.

models.label: Z_image_Turbo CLIP
models.setupHint: Install qwen_3_4b.safetensors where ComfyUI's CLIPLoader can find it.

models.label: Krea-2 text encoder
models.setupHint: Install qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors in ComfyUI models/text_encoders.

models.label: Qwen-Image 2.1 VAE

licenseGate.name: Qwen Research License Agreement
licenseGate.summary: Qwen restricts these weights to research and evaluation use; commercial use needs a separate licence from Qwen. Read the licence before downloading them or publishing work made with them.

models.setupHint: Install qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors in ComfyUI models/vae. Not qwen_image_vae.safetensors (Krea-2) or qwen_image_layered_vae.safetensors (Unflatten).

models.label: Qwen image VAE
